notes: A1: aura_oid=37, enchant_target=112 (llanowar elves, zone=Battlefield, ctrl=1), P1 gy=4
A2: enchanted Elves attacked (P0 life 20->19); cant-attack restriction dropped

Lost in Thought's combined restriction/escape clause is dropped end-to-end on this build; see assertion notes
limitations: Browser UI not exercised; native engine via two human-client seats.
12x spell/creature density is a test-harness convenience (engine accepts >4-of for custom games).
The prebuilt server has no standalone state-restore; states are authoritative exports (restorable only via full game replay).
Escape payment (A5) not driven: no escape action was offered, so there was nothing to pay.
setup_line: P0: 12x lost in thought + 12x thought scour + 36x island; P1: 12x llanowar elves + 12x grizzly bears + 36x forest
contract_line: Cast Lost in Thought on P1's Llanowar Elves with >=3 cards in P1's graveyard; assert the enchanted creature cannot attack (A2) and cannot activate abilities (A3), that an exile-3 escape is offered (A4), and that an unenchanted Bear attacks normally (A6)
driver_notes: A3 first evaluated 'passed' on pool_after={}; the pool was read ~1.5s after the attempt, by which time the game had advanced to DeclareAttackers (mana empties on phase change). Server log shows the ActivateAbility was applied (event_count=4, no rejection), so the activation succeeded and A3 is failed. Corrected post-run from server_excerpts.log; scenario file patched to read the pool before phase advance on future runs.
